atts.title:
Universes in
Glass.
atts.subtitle: Miniature ecosystems forged with time, moss, and light. A fragment of autumn magic preserved eternally in your space.
atts.heading: h1

atts.label: The Process

atts.title:
Life breathing
in the void.
atts.subtitle: Each terrarium is a self-sustaining biome. Tiny cabins house warm light diodes that mimic the glow of a hearth, while living moss purifies its own atmosphere through hand-blown glass.
atts.heading: h2

atts.title: Perpetual Flora
atts.content: Meticulous selection of flora that thrives in closed environments, creating micro-forests that require zero maintenance.

atts.title: Scaled Architecture
atts.content: Hand-carved structures in noble woods, treated to resist moisture and maintain their millimeter precision.

atts.title: Micro-Rivers
atts.content: Epoxy resin cast with natural pigments that simulate water currents, reflecting the internal light of the ecosystem.

atts.title: Twilight Glow
atts.content: Integrated lighting with amber temperature (2200K) LED filaments, powered by invisible inductive charging bases.

atts.title: The Autumn Haven
atts.subtitle: Discover the flagship collection. Each piece is unique, numbered, and contains an unrepeatable landscape.
atts.heading: h2

atts.title: The Valley Mill
atts.content: A mill suspended over a resin river, surrounded by copper foliage.

atts.title: The Alchemist's Cabin
atts.content: A steep tower embedded in basalt rock with climbing moss.

atts.title: Bridge of Souls
atts.content: A stone arch over dark waters, flanked by golden trees.
